annotation_rule: Independent manual review against each field's preselected RecruiterProposition, sourced JD requirement and first_check. Model-selected Handles and blind audit are not entailment proof. A direct scope question without an established participation fact is an unsupported presupposition. A source-backed extra technical topic is still unsupported against the frozen single first_check intent, but is not a fabricated technical fact. An implicit whether-plus-scope conjunction is uncertain rather than automatically called a confirmed assertion.
